sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-09 and 2016-12-09, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C07671-K2 belonging to customer C07671. Flagged transaction 3526826 in the amount of $35.66 was executed via undocumented. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device (Windows |  | chrome 66.0 | ). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C09988-K1, C08106-K1, C11891-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-4124, CC-4086) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $35.66. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.

stop_reason: Graph pattern and customer validation definitively confirmed unauthorized compromise. Containment actions established.
